faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What is modern interior design for a Pitampura home?

Clean lines, an open layout, neutral colours and practical furniture. It suits builder floors, where it makes rooms feel more spacious.

Can a modern home include a puja room?

Yes. A puja room can be designed in a simple, modern style with good lighting and storage, so it fits the rest of the home.

Is modern design good for offices too?

Yes. Simple layouts, good lighting and durable modern finishes work well for offices, clinics and showrooms.

How do you add warmth to modern interior design?

Wood, fabric, warm lighting and a few personal pieces keep a modern home from feeling cold.
